Repository-wide searches for the exact event title, December 7 date, Ryogoku Kokugikan, and the proposed stable ID returned no matching canonical, curated, or processed RADAR record before publication. The case is the living-master context joined to a new-work cycle and a specific large-scale Tokyo return, not Hosono's fame alone. Stage 2 assigns A+. The current rubric calls for actively making room for an unusually strong artist, setting, or cultural connection, which this clearly satisfies. Scarcity was explicitly challenged before finalizing: Hosono performed a Tokyo prelude show on September 2 and remains actively performing, while no primary or authoritative source found in this pass labels December 7 a farewell, final performance, or otherwise non-repeatable event. A+ therefore captures the recommendation without turning a one-night album-cycle highlight into an S-tier protect-the-night claim. events.subtitle: The Yours Sincerely Tour in Tokyo
events.category: Japanese master / new-album tour / cross-genre pop and experimental music
events.factual_description: Haruomi Hosono will present Haruomi Hosono The Yours Sincerely Tour in Tokyo at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Sumida, Tokyo, on Monday, December 7, 2026. The announced schedule is 17:30 doors and an 18:30 start. Current-day authoritative announcement coverage describes the concert as the largest domestic highlight of the Yours Sincerely album project, following the album's September 11 worldwide release and Hosono's September 16 Radio City Music Hall and September 20 Greek Theatre dates. The authorized Lawson Ticket special landing supplied with the announcement states that the earliest official presale is scheduled to begin September 3 at 19:00 JST; at the time of this check, before that opening time, the destination resolves to Lawson's Haruomi Hosono artist landing rather than live event inventory. No supporting personnel or face-price information for the December 7 concert was announced in the verified sources checked for this batch, so none is inferred.

enrichment.note: Date, venue, doors/start time, album-cycle framing and the announced earliest presale time are verified from multiple current-day authoritative reports carrying the official concert announcement. Lawson Ticket supplies the authorized special landing specifically linked for this announcement; before the announced 19:00 JST presale opening it resolves to Hosono's Lawson artist landing, so no claim is made that ticket inventory is already live. Apple Music supplies an exact pre-release Yours Sincerely album destination. Supporting personnel and face prices are not yet announced and are not inferred.

The one-night Ryogoku setting and new-work culmination warrant actively making room, but Hosono's September 2 Tokyo prelude performance and ongoing live activity mean the available evidence does not establish the kind of farewell, final opportunity, or demonstrably unlikely-to-recur context required for S.

en.why_it_matters: Hosono's importance is not the reason to list every date he plays. This one has a specific shape: a new record arriving after decades of moving between folk, electronics, ambient music and pop, a two-city US run built around it, then a single large Tokyo statement at Ryogoku. The interest is hearing a living architect of several Japanese musical lineages use a new album rather than a retrospective as the center of gravity, while the older songbook remains close enough to make the night a conversation across his own history.
en.trip_verdict: If Greater Tokyo is in play on December 7, I would actively make room for Ryogoku and let the concert anchor the evening. I would not reorganize an entire Japan itinerary around the date on scarcity grounds alone, because Hosono is still performing and the current announcement does not present this as a farewell or final opportunity.

es.why_it_matters: La importancia histórica de Hosono no basta para meter al RADAR cada fecha que toque. Ésta sí tiene una forma concreta: un disco nuevo después de décadas cruzando folk, electrónica, ambient y pop; una gira estadounidense de dos ciudades construida alrededor del álbum; y después una sola declaración grande en Tokio, en Ryogoku. Lo interesante es escuchar a uno de los arquitectos vivos de varias genealogías de la música japonesa poner el peso de la noche en obra nueva y no en una retrospectiva, con el cancionero anterior suficientemente cerca como para que el concierto dialogue con toda su propia historia.
es.trip_verdict: Si Greater Tokyo está en juego el 7 de diciembre, sí haría espacio activamente para Ryogoku y dejaría que el concierto ancle la noche. No reorganizaría todo un viaje a Japón sólo por escasez: Hosono sigue tocando y el anuncio actual no presenta esta fecha como despedida ni como última oportunidad.
